final_message:
`createUser` now accepts an optional `nickname`, and `getUser` returns it, or `null` when it isn't set. `npm test` passes all 3 tests, including the two in `test/users-nickname.test.js`.

- **`src/api/users.js`:** `createUser` takes `nickname` (default `null`) and stores it. `getUser` returns `nickname`.
- **`migrations/003_add_nickname.js`:** this new migration adds the `nickname` column to `users`. The database rejects inserts into columns it doesn't know, so the column had to exist.

The `migrations/` README says the DBA team owns that folder. I didn't touch the applied migrations (001 and 002), but you may want the DBA team to review the new file.
